thread:
Zoe Chen: quick design review — p95 card + heatmap after today's infra change
Arun Patel: saw the mock, overall looks good
Maya Lopez: main concern: heatmap legend uses light yellow for high latency — problematic for deuteranopes
Ben Carter: agreed. propose single-hue sequential (dark -> light) + pattern overlay for top bins
Maya Lopez: also p95 tooltip shows 'p95 latency' but elsewhere we use ms units. should be 'p95 (ms)'
Zoe Chen: good catch on units
Arun Patel: timepicker presets — keep last 15m/1h/24h or add a middle option like 6h? some users want 6h for deploy windows
Sam Rivera: can we support keyboard stepper? left/right to nudge window by current range
Maya Lopez: accessibility nit: the preset dropdown needs aria-label and focus styles
Zoe Chen: figma: https://figma.com/file/abcd1234 — updated with compact and expanded card states
Ben Carter: small UX nit: sampling toggle default? current mock sets sampling OFF, ops prefers ON (auto-sample)
Maya Lopez: default should be "auto-sampling: on" with a short tooltip explaining downsampling vs raw, otherwise people think data missing
Arun Patel: performance concern: continuous client-side heatmap with high-cardinality routes will kill the browser. suggest server-side downsampling + explicit badge that data is downsampled
Sam Rivera: +1 for a 'downsampled' badge in header so users aren't confused when lines get smoother
Zoe Chen: copy tweak: change label from 'Sampling rate' to 'Trace sampling (approx.)' — less ambiguous
Maya Lopez: a11y-bot: legend labels fail contrast (3.8:1). target >= 4.5:1 for body text
a11y-bot: Recommended: darken legend text color to #1f2937 or increase weight to 600; also ensure hover states remain >= 3:1 for interactive elements
Ben Carter: prototyping pattern overlay. example CSS — helps colorblind folks and prints well:
```css
.heatmap-cell.pattern {
  background-image: linear-gradient(45deg, rgba(0,0,0,0.06) 25%, transparent 25%);
}
.heatmap-legend { font-weight: 600; color: #1f2937; }
```
Arun Patel: percentiles: should we surface p50/p95/p99 toggles? maybe keep p95 default but add quick pills for others
Zoe Chen: keep p95 default, add a small dropdown "percentiles" with checkboxes and a compact legend for multiple lines
Maya Lopez: keyboard nav: zoom + pan must have aria-controls and not steal focus when streaming updates happen
Sam Rivera: UX question: in compact dashboard view, do we collapse heatmap to a 1-row sparkline? feedback from analytics: yes, collapse but keep tooltip on hover to expand
Ben Carter: also, streaming updates should not refocus or collapse expanded tooltips — preserve user interaction state
Zoe Chen: I'll update the figma states and add a note to the PR: preserve focus & interaction during live updates
Maya Lopez: microcopy suggestion under heatmap: change "Colors represent latency" -> "Percentiles across requests; lighter = faster, darker = slower"
Arun Patel: sync needed with infra about sampling endpoints — some routes only expose aggregated histograms right now
Sam Rivera: filing ticket: ENG-UI-1234 to track infra changes + UX work
Zoe Chen: thanks all :thumbsup:
